text:
sophie-fin: Heads up: nightly reconciliation flagged 27 "phantom" invoices generated on 2025-03-08 (phinv-20250308-01 .. phinv-20250308-27). None of them have corresponding Stripe charges or payout lines. Recon put them in BLOCKED for manual review.

liam-eng: yikes. starting triage. which integration path created them? webhook consumer or billing-batch?

sophie-fin: looks like webhook consumer — source="stripe_event" on the invoice row. Amounts are mixed but total ~ $19,450.

morgan-ops: checking ingress logs for edge-proxy around 2025-03-08T05:10-05:18 UTC. seeing lots of 504s then retries. could be related.

stripe-bot: Stripe: event evt_4PZlmn had delivery attempt 1=200, 2=504, 3=504. Latest status: delivered.

liam-eng: quick log excerpt:
```
[2025-03-08T05:12:03Z] POST /integrations/stripe/webhook 504 edge-proxy-12
payload.id=evt_4PZlmn...
headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json","User-Agent":"Stripe/1.0"} // Idempotency-Key header missing/truncated
```

liam-eng: seems the edge-proxy IPA module truncates long header values (we pass a UUID-based Idempotency-Key). When truncation happens, our consumer library treats the header as absent and creates a new invoice for the replayed event.

hesa-acct: can the consumer require a matching charge before creating an invoice? We cannot have invoices without charges or chargeable line items.

liam-eng: agree. immediate plan:
 - hotfix webhook-consumer: if Idempotency-Key header missing/invalid, use event.id as fallback and dedupe using event.id;
 - stop automatic invoice creation if Stripe charge lookup returns no charge or charge.status!="succeeded"; instead mark event REVIEW_REQUIRED.

morgan-ops: deploying hotfix to canary now. image: webhook-consumer:2.2.1-edge-fix
cicd-bot: Deployment queued: webhook-consumer -> webhook-consumer:2.2.1-edge-fix by liam-eng
cicd-bot: Deployment succeeded: webhook-consumer -> 2.2.1-edge-fix at 05:22 UTC

liam-eng: dry-run cleanup script output:
```
$ scripts/find_phantom_invoices --date 2025-03-08 --format=summary
Candidates found: 27
 - 3 invoices relinkable after secondary charge lookup (charge id discovered via metadata)
 - 24 invoices have no matching charge and were created via webhook-consumer retries where Idempotency-Key was absent
Total exposure: $19,450.00
```

hesa-acct: per policy need CFO signoff to delete created invoices > $500. @leo-cfo please advise.

leo-cfo: leo-cfo: approved for this incident only. go ahead and remove invoices that are orphaned; keep complete audit log.

liam-eng: running cleanup with audit: `scripts/cleanup_orphan_invoices --date 2025-03-08 --delete --audit=/var/log/audit/phantom-20250308.log`

[~8m later]

liam-eng: cleanup completed: 24 invoices deleted, 3 relinked to existing charges. Audit file: /var/log/audit/phantom-20250308.log. Reconciliation job now passes for that date.

hesa-acct: ledger check: totals reconcile with Stripe payouts and GL. I'll create a JIRA to capture follow-ups and adjustments to the monthly close checklist.

liam-eng: PR: https://github.com/redwood/integration/pull/4620 (consumer fallback + charge-existence guard). Runbook updated: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/webhook-guidelines.md

morgan-ops: created infra ticket to patch edge-proxy header truncation and add test coverage: INFRA-3210

sophie-fin: summary/action items:
 - liam-eng: hotfix deployed and PR merged (done)
 - morgan-ops: edge-proxy header truncation fix (INFRA-3210)
 - hesa-acct: JIRA + ledger verification (in progress)
 - finance: monitor next 48h for repeat, escalate if any new phantom invoices appear :mag_right:

sophie-fin: closing thread for now. thanks all.
